Implement JSON Pointer resolvePointer (RFC 6901)

Add resolvePointer(document, pointer) in src/index.ts. It resolves an
RFC 6901 pointer against a JSON document, decoding ~1 then ~0, and throws
on malformed pointers and on pointers that do not resolve. Tests cover the
RFC section 5 examples and the error paths. README documents the export.
